content_sections.heading: Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 223 Anganwadi Karyakatri vacancies have been notified across 9 Child Development Projects (Bal Vikas Pariyojnas) in Jhansi district, as per the table below.

content_sections.heading: Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible for the advertised posts. The applicant must be a permanent resident of the Ward/Gram Sabha to which the vacant post belongs. Where no eligible candidate from that category is available within the Gram Sabha, a permanent resident of the concerned Nyay Panchayat becomes eligible. In urban (Nagariya) areas, the online residence proof issued by the Tehsil must compulsorily mention the relevant ward number/name. The minimum educational qualification for all advertised Anganwadi Karyakatri posts is Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent , and the maximum considered qualification is Postgraduate . The merit list will be prepared on the basis of educational qualification. Residence and caste certificates will be accepted only if issued by the Tehsil with an updated online digital signature and are verifiable online. Income certificates will be accepted only if issued by a competent authority as per UP Government Revenue Section-9 Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj0-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended), and are verifiable online. For widow applicants, a death certificate and an attested copy of the family register issued by the Gram Panchayat Adhikari/concerned Nagar Nikay will be valid. For divorced and abandoned/separated women, a legal order issued by the Hon'ble Court will be valid.

content_sections.heading: Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 35 years Age will be calculated as on the cut-off date of 1 July 2026 Only the date of birth entered in the High School marksheet/certificate will be considered valid for age calculation

content_sections.heading: Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Honorarium
content_sections.text: The Anganwadi Karyakatri posts are engaged on a mandey (honorarium) basis , as stated in the notification. The exact honorarium amount is not specified in this notification.

content_sections.heading: Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is merit-based - a merit list will be prepared on the basis of the candidate's educational qualification (from minimum Intermediate to maximum Postgraduate). Preference in recruitment will be given to applicants belonging to the BPL (Below Poverty Line) category , with the BPL income limit determined as per Samaj Kalyan Anubhag-2, UP Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 (as amended). The notification does not specify a written examination or interview stage for this recruitment. The final decision on recruitment to the vacant posts rests with the Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the departmental website https://www.upanganwadibharti.in . Fill the online application form carefully and accurately in the prescribed format available on the website. Upload self-attested, clean and legible scanned copies of the required documents (residence certificate, caste certificate if applicable, income certificate if applicable, educational certificates, and other supporting documents as specified on the portal). Verify all entries before final submission - applications with incorrect or fabricated facts/figures/educational records are liable to be rejected. Submit the application online before the last date, 7 September 2026, midnight (12:00 AM) . Applications will be accepted online only through the departmental website within the prescribed timeframe; offline application forms will not be accepted under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Complete eligibility details, village/ward-wise vacancy break-up, and reservation details are displayed at the notice boards of the District Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil, Development Block, and Child Development Project offices, and are also uploaded on the departmental website. Documents not specifically mentioned in the application will not be considered valid; any deficiency in the application, or any incorrect/fabricated facts, figures, or educational records, will result in rejection of candidature. Preference will be given to BPL category applicants, subject to the applicable income-limit government order. For more information, candidates may contact the District Child Development Project Officer's office, Vikas Bhavan, or the District Programme Officer's office, Jhansi, during office hours as per the prescribed schedule. The number of vacant posts may increase or decrease, and the final decision on recruitment rests with the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q1. What is Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the District Programme Officer, Jhansi, to fill 223 honorarium-based Anganwadi Karyakatri (Anganwadi Worker) posts across 9 Child Development Projects in Jhansi district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 223 vacancies are notified across 9 projects: Babina (13), Baragaon (35), Bamaur (36), Bangra (17), Chirgaon (25), Gursarai (12), Mauranipur (28), Moth (30), and Jhansi Shahar (27).

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only female candidates who are permanent residents of the concerned Ward/Gram Sabha (or, in its absence, the concerned Nyay Panchayat) of the vacant post are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 7 September 2026, midnight (12:00 AM).

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th) or equivalent, and the maximum considered is Postgraduate. The merit list is prepared based on educational qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age, calculated as on the cut-off date of 1 July 2026, based on the date of birth in the High School certificate.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for Jhansi Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply only online through the departmental website https://www.upanganwadibharti.in by carefully filling the prescribed application form and uploading the required self-attested documents.
